test_cases.precondition: app open on each member's screen
test_cases.action: tap one live instance of every distinct appearance in the candidate and compare destinations
test_cases.expected_result: do these both open the same add-a-friend flow?
test_cases.confirms_if: every appearance reaches the same destination at the same scope
test_cases.observed_result: FIND A FRIEND (Quests) and ADD FRIENDS (Feed) both open the "Find your friends" page (Choose from contacts / Search by name / Share follow link); from Quests it also carries a greyed CLAIM REWARD button

test_cases.action: from the screen carrying one rendering, look for the job on the screen carrying the other and judge whether it is recognizable before tapping
test_cases.expected_result: the second rendering is recognizable as the same job
test_cases.confirms_if: a user who learned one rendering would not recognize the other on its surface
test_cases.overturns_if: surface, scope or explicit wording makes the second rendering recognizable
test_cases.observed_result: from a candidate: both tapped live and open the same "Find your friends" page. Different surfaces (a quest row on Quests vs a promo card on Feed); both are worded buttons naming "FRIEND(S)" with near-synonym verbs (FIND / ADD), so a user who learned one would recognize the other. Justification: different surfaces, both explicit
